subject: [hw] T02 -> P03: n2vcd_cli command line, output lines and where the .h264 goes
body: For tests/phone/40-daemon-encode.md I need the exact phone-side invocation and pass lines of your client tool: binary name/path, `enc in.yuv WxH fps bitrate out.h264` (is that final?), the per-frame stdout lines, exit codes, and how the output file is fetched by the main session. Also: does it need a UNIX socket path or does it use the relay by default on the phone? A literal example with expected output would let me make the pass criteria exact.
